senses.gloss: c. (b. h.; preced. wds.) [heaviness, seat of anger and melancholy,] liver.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 61b:1">Ber. 61ᵇ</cite> top <he>כ׳ כועס ומרה וכ׳</he> the liver is excited, and the gall pours a drop over it and quiets it.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 3:1">Ḥull. III, 1</cite> <he>ניטל הכ׳</he>; <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 3:2">ib. 2</cite> <he>ניטלה הכ׳</he> if the liver of an animal is gone.

<cite ref="Mishnah Arakhin 5:2">Arakh. V, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Arakhin 20a:17">20ᵃ</cite>) <he>ערך כְּבֵדִי עלי</he> (Bab. ed. <he>כְּבֵידִי</he>) I vow the value of my liver (being a vital organ); a. fr.
